message.content:
The Drift -5°C Synthetic is warmer (rated -5°C vs. the Ember's 0°C), but the Ember 0°C Down is far lighter at 850 g vs. 1700 g — exactly half the weight, and also $120 more ($259 vs. $139).

So it's a trade-off: pick the Drift if you want more warmth per dollar, or the Ember if you want to pack light. (If 0°C isn't warm enough for your trip, there's also an Ember -10°C version at 1150 g for $349.)
